claim_scope: fixed-capacity Maple c2/c4/c8 resident decode helper; excludes model load, prompt prefill, public scheduler admission, and server throughput

kernel.rollback: HIPENGINE_MAPLE_BATCH_AFFINE4_ROWREUSE_EXACT=0 selects the original group64_batched all-row primitive
kernel.mechanism: one block owns one vocabulary row across all request rows; each packed word, BF16 scale, and BF16 bias is loaded once while every request replays the original per-thread accumulation order and 128-thread FP32 reduction tree

protocol.publication_command: env -u HIPENGINE_MAPLE_BATCH_AFFINE4_ROWREUSE_EXACT GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-maple-hipcc-version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 .venv/bin/python scripts/maple_batch_decode_bench.py --model deepgrove/maple-preview-2bit-mlx --backend hip_gfx1151 --suite benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl --heldout benchmarks/prompts/gdn-prefill-category-heldouts.jsonl --steps 64 --repetitions 3 --warmup-steps 8 --natural-gate-steps 8 --out /tmp/maple-d1-rowreuse-selector-unset-retained.json
protocol.qualification_command: env HIPENGINE_MAPLE_BATCH_AFFINE4_ROWREUSE_EXACT=1 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-maple-hipcc-version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 .venv/bin/python scripts/maple_batch_decode_bench.py --model deepgrove/maple-preview-2bit-mlx --backend hip_gfx1151 --suite benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl --heldout benchmarks/prompts/gdn-prefill-category-heldouts.jsonl --steps 64 --repetitions 3 --warmup-steps 8 --natural-gate-steps 8 --out /tmp/maple-d1-rowreuse-clean-candidate.json
protocol.profile_command: env HIPENGINE_MAPLE_BATCH_AFFINE4_ROWREUSE_EXACT=1 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-maple-hipcc-version.txt .venv/bin/python scripts/maple_phase_profile.py --model deepgrove/maple-preview-2bit-mlx --backend hip_gfx1151 --version-file /tmp/hipengine-maple-hipcc-version.txt --raw-root /tmp/maple-d1-rowreuse-c8-profile-raw --phase decode_c8 --out /tmp/maple-d1-rowreuse-c8-profile.json
protocol.timing_scope: resident MapleBatchRunner plus MapleContinuousBatcher owner loop

reclaimed_slot.description: slot 0 completes and resets, slot 1 advances through a sparse round, then a third request reuses slot 0; all trajectories equal independent serial decode

correctness.state_contract: the new head launches after final RMSNorm, writes only the logits buffer, and is FP32-bit exact to the original head; hidden, KVLiveSpans, K/V cache, and request-position buffers have no new writer or arithmetic boundary

notes: These are exact full-vocabulary affine4 helper rows, not approximate FlashHead results.
Every active request requires logits; row reuse shares immutable weight traffic but preserves one exact result per request.
The helper remains outside the public generation scheduler and does not include batched prompt prefill.
